tiers.tier: Tier 1: Unaligned Explicit attn_mask[B, 1, S, S] (Silent SDPA Math Fallback)
Tier 2: 16-Byte Padded Explicit attn_mask (Cutlass Memory-Efficient Backend)
Tier 3: FlexAttention BlockMask (128x128 Sparse Tile Mask for Custom Masks)
Tier 4: Strict sdpa_kernel(FLASH_ATTENTION) + is_causal=True & Varlen cu_seqlens

fallback_triggers.fallback_penalty: Drops to Cutlass (3.1x slower) or Math (13.8x slower + 32GB OOM)
Drops to C++ MATH backend (allocates full [B, H, S, S] FP32 matrix!)

fallback_triggers.trigger: RoPE / QK-Norm outputs `q` in `float32` while `v` is `bfloat16`
fallback_triggers.fallback_penalty: Upcasts or falls back to slow FP32 path without warning

fallback_triggers.trigger: Expanded broadcast view `attn_mask.expand(B, H, S, S)` with `stride == 0`
fallback_triggers.fallback_penalty: Crashes or falls back to O(S^2) Math backward
